method: Arithmetic mean of encoded sRGB pixels in the central 80% of the official code-specific photographic swatch; pixels with alpha below 250 excluded. Display approximation only: not measured physical colour or manufacturer-declared RGB. 5x5 block means provide a descriptive variation check; maximum pairwise RGB distance >=65 flags broad photographic variation, not a definitive multicolour classification.
limitations: Metallic reflection, pearlescence, fluorescence, glow-in-the-dark behaviour and variegation cannot be represented faithfully by one average RGB. No image content is redistributed.
